topic.readerProblem: A marketer or founder wants to know whether to pay for an AI SEO / GEO course or certification, what a good curriculum covers, and what to learn for free instead.
topic.connection: AEOeye's work is measuring whether AI engines name a brand; the page teaches the same audit-change-remeasure loop and the crawler-access and measurement basics the audit checks.

assessment: The page gives a verdict (a certificate is a weak signal, courses are worth it only if they force a real audit), a six-topic curriculum checklist, a table of four courses with cost, length and credential taken from each provider's own page, and a free self-study path built on primary sources. It uses AEOeye's crawler access study with its n and caveats and describes what aeoeye.com itself does. It says plainly that we have not taken the courses, does not rank them by quality, and leaves out Udemy-style marketplace prices it could not verify.

sources.supports: SEO best practices still apply to Google's generative AI features; no need for llms.txt, special markup or content chunking.
GEO paper abstract: strategies can boost visibility by up to 40% in generative engine responses; efficacy varies across domains.
OAI-SearchBot and GPTBot are independent robots.txt settings; robots.txt updates can take about 24 hours to take effect for search.
PerplexityBot surfaces and links sites in Perplexity search results and is not used to crawl content for AI foundation models.
Search Console generative AI performance report shows impressions in AI Overviews and AI Mode; rolled out to all websites worldwide as of August 31, 2026.
HubSpot Academy offers two free AEO certifications (AEO Fundamentals; Implementing AEO With HubSpot) and an AEO Dual Certified badge for both; length not stated.
Edureka's Introduction to GEO on Coursera: enroll for free, 5 modules, about 9 hours, beginner, shareable certificate, AI-graded assignments, certificate needs purchase or Coursera Plus.
Ahrefs Academy lists a free Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) course, 12 lessons, 1 hr 26 min, and a separate Brand Radar course.
Semrush Academy lists the AI Search Operating System course (10 lessons, 41 minutes, Certification) under Free Online Marketing Courses.
